observed_failure.root_reason: A genuine Linux kernel fix generated631 authenticated advisory reasons, but staging rejected the record against a separate100-reason limit. No PR was created.
observed_failure.router_reason: GO-2026-5932 names unmaintained x/crypto/openpgp. Its only recorded module fix is a pseudoversion; the resolver rejected the whole module inventory before the mandatory source scanner could establish applicability.

kernel_fix.input_reconstruction: Both changed snapshot-input hashes exactly match the original hosted candidate; its archive-evidence signature verified against the trusted Main source.

candidate_budget.control: Producer and every existing consumer validate one shared candidate schema and budgets. Every advisory and its evidence hash remains bound to the candidate identity; no truncation or skipped checks.

repairs.go_advisory_applicability: A migration-only advisory may leave module inventory unchanged only when every affected package is absent from a complete test-inclusive Go import graph. A successful mandatory govulncheck source scan is still required. Imported or unknown affected packages, malformed/empty import graphs and scanner failures block; prereleases and dependency migrations are never selected automatically.
repairs.github_descriptions: Use one bounded PR/issue reason summary for large batches; keep every advisory ID and evidence hash in the content-bound candidate and signed archive.

regressions: The real631-advisory staging case fails before the repair and passes afterward.
Old OpenPGP inventory handling fails before source applicability is checked.
Altered advisory hashes invalidate candidate identity.
Reason-count/serialized-byte limits remain enforced by producer and consumer.
Imported/unknown/empty/malformed applicability and source-scan failures remain blocked.
validation.local_real_go_import_replay: Unavailable in this environment: the installed Go shim reports repository root not found. No successful real local Go replay is claimed. Actual hosted router resolution remains required after deploying the independently verified shared source.

required_release_validation: Fresh complete current-head package/native/security qualification and actual independent human approval. Then verify the immutable release and fresh signed assessment before closing security issues.
router_deployment_followup: After the new root source has a verified immutable production release, update router-policy-agent shared maintenance source pins and its manifest under a separate fully qualified independently reviewed workflow-control PR. Do not update discovery-bridge solely for version parity.
